messages.text: 给已有角色林岚（55627d2f-0656-4172-8be9-159934613032）增加一张脸部＋正面／背面／侧面的 V3 Simple 多视图。给已有场景旧候车厅（3af88500-7116-4f76-bf4c-92857cbf1003）增加入口回看的角度和长凳细节两张图片，不新增场景实体。两者都等待各自已选主图，但目前还没选；保留原资料、服装和布局。不要再建同名实体，不自动生成；保存可审阅的工作流方案。没有给出朝向、尺度与完整平面布局，不要补成直线、同轴或南北方向。

我先读取方法、两个实体完整资料和当前工作流能力，再给出方案。

方法、两个实体完整资料与工作流能力都读完了：两个实体各有 0 张已选图、`sceneSpatial` 为 missing/draft、项目 `visualStyle` 为空。按“只增图片步骤、不建实体”的方式提交两份可审阅方案。

两份方案已保存为待审阅提案（未生成、未改任何已有资料）：

**1) 林岚（55627d2f-…）· planId 860a5c20-142d-4212-b3f3-267dd157614f**
- 只增加 1 个图片步骤：`v3_face_front_back_side`（role=three_view，模型 `qwen-v3-simple-face-front-back-side`，layout=脸部＋正／背／侧）。
- `useMainAppearance=true`、`useBaseAppearance=false`、`referenceAssetIds=[]` → 挂起，等林岚主图选定后批次执行。
- 固定项：短黑发中一缕白发、灰色长外套、深蓝裤子、同一人物、无风格漂移；不因职业新增道具／配饰／伤势；无电子设备（世界规则）。
- 未定项明列：画风（项目 `visualStyle` 为空）、脸型与五官细节、白发位置、鞋型、外套长度与纽扣等，需主图选定后核对。

**2) 旧候车厅（3af88500-…）· planId 04c7e5a5-02ba-4e5d-9ed8-e3de8c06b026**
- 增加 2 个图片步骤，未新增场景实体：`look_back_at_entrance`（scene_angle）、`bench_detail`（scene_detail），模型 `qwen-image-2.1`，同样 `useMainAppearance=true` + 空引用 → 两张都挂起等主图。
- 只承认已登记事实：入口、长凳区、站台门；入口与长凳区相邻、长凳区通向站台门；不写同轴／直线／左右／朝向；朝向、绝对尺度、完整平面布局全部保留为未确认；不新增未登记固定结构；取景不出现人物（仅取景要求，不等于场景永远无人）。

需要你确认的 3 个点（决定执行前是否要改提示词）：
1. “入口回看”我按**从厅内长凳区一侧朝入口区域回看**来写；如果你要的是**从入口朝厅内看**，我改成反向。
2. 画风：项目 `visualStyle` 为空，两个步骤都填了 `original`（严格跟随各自主图渲染风格）。是否照此，或指定某个风格（写实／电影感／动画等）？
3. 长凳细节我写成“裁到座面、边框与支脚，含周围地面”，且不预设木制或金属；你希望更近的单件特写，还是带一点长凳区环境的近景？

确认后到“实体创作工作流”接受提案；在选定主图前这两组步骤都不会出图。

images.prompt:
Interior view of the old waiting hall (旧候车厅) at night, in an ordinary contemporary city, empty of people. Camera stands inside the hall on the bench-area side and looks back toward the entrance area, so the hall interior occupies the foreground and the entrance area is seen ahead in the depth of the frame.
Documented layout facts only: the entrance area and the bench area are adjacent, and the bench area leads to the platform door. Show only these areas and the structures visible in the selected main reference image of this hall. Do not assume or depict any straight, coaxial, left–right, opposite, or north–south arrangement between the entrance, the bench area, and the platform door.
Materials and atmosphere: worn, old public waiting hall, aged paint, dull floor, plain ceiling, night ambience, even nondescript practical lighting consistent with the reference image; nothing glossy or renovated.
Project world rule: no electronic or digital devices anywhere; every fixture and prop is mechanical or hand-made (analogue signage, metal fittings, wooden or metal benches).
Framing: no people in frame — this is a framing requirement for this shot only, not a claim that the hall is always empty. Consistent perspective, no fisheye, no text overlay, no watermark, no labels. Preserve any structure, material, and colour already visible in the reference image; do not relocate or redesign it.

images.prompt:
Composition: Clean 3:2 landscape layout on a warm off-white background with generous spacing. No frames, borders, dividers, text, labels, watermarks, or logos. Soft, even neutral studio lighting across all panels. Rendering style, line weight, texture, and shading must strictly match the selected main reference image of the same subject.
Left Column (20% width): Exactly one large, straight-on head-and-shoulders portrait of the reference subject with a neutral expression. Clearly show the face and hairstyle: short black hair with a single streak of white hair. No expression grid, no stacked portraits, no additional head crops.
Right Row (80% width): Exactly three full-height, identically scaled figures arranged left to right: Front View, Back View, and Clean Side Profile. Neutral relaxed stance, head to feet visible in every figure, including shoes. Clothing exactly as in the reference: grey long coat, dark blue trousers. Soft oval floor shadows. The face portrait and all three full-body views show the same subject.
Setting note: ordinary contemporary city, night-shift station attendant, no magic. No electronic or digital devices on the person (project world rule); props, if any, are mechanical or hand-made. Keep the plain, unglamorous working look.
Consistency & Constraints: Preserve exact identity, the short black hair with one white streak, facial features, grey long coat, dark blue trousers, asymmetry, and any accessories visible in the reference. Do not add, redesign, beautify, age, or extrapolate items based on lore or profession, and do not invent props, accessories, or injuries that are not visible in the reference. No extra characters, shifting proportions, extra limbs, or style drift between views.

短黑发中有一缕白发，发型与发色保持不变。
服装保持资料描述：灰色长外套、深蓝裤子；不新增换装。
身份与外观一致：夜班女管理员，不做美化、年轻化或风格漂移。
普通现实城市、无魔法；画面中不出现电子设备（项目世界规则）。
不因职业推断新增道具、配饰、徽章或制服改写；不新增未在主图出现的道具、配饰或伤势。
背景为暖白／浅色棚拍底，无文字、无标签、无边框、无水印。
仅改变视图角度，不改变已被选主图确认的可见特征。
steps.label: 林岚 · 脸部＋正／背／侧 多视图（待主图）
steps.prompt:
Composition: Clean 3:2 landscape layout on a warm off-white background with generous spacing. No frames, borders, dividers, text, labels, watermarks, or logos. Soft, even neutral studio lighting across all panels. Rendering style, line weight, texture, and shading must strictly match the selected main reference image of the same subject.
Left Column (20% width): Exactly one large, straight-on head-and-shoulders portrait of the reference subject with a neutral expression. Clearly show the face and hairstyle: short black hair with a single streak of white hair. No expression grid, no stacked portraits, no additional head crops.
Right Row (80% width): Exactly three full-height, identically scaled figures arranged left to right: Front View, Back View, and Clean Side Profile. Neutral relaxed stance, head to feet visible in every figure, including shoes. Clothing exactly as in the reference: grey long coat, dark blue trousers. Soft oval floor shadows. The face portrait and all three full-body views show the same subject.
Setting note: ordinary contemporary city, night-shift station attendant, no magic. No electronic or digital devices on the person (project world rule); props, if any, are mechanical or hand-made. Keep the plain, unglamorous working look.
Consistency & Constraints: Preserve exact identity, the short black hair with one white streak, facial features, grey long coat, dark blue trousers, asymmetry, and any accessories visible in the reference. Do not add, redesign, beautify, age, or extrapolate items based on lore or profession, and do not invent props, accessories, or injuries that are not visible in the reference. No extra characters, shifting proportions, extra limbs, or style drift between views.
steps.purpose: 为已有角色补齐脸部与正／背／侧三向可复用形象视图，供后续镜头与变体保持同一张脸和同一套服装；本步骤依赖林岚自己的主图，主图未选定前保持挂起。
unknowns: 项目 visualStyle 为空，最终画风只能沿用林岚主图的渲染风格；未选主图前画风未知。
主图未选定：脸型、五官细节、白发所在位置与分缝、鞋型、身高比例、外套长度与纽扣样式等无法核对。
林岚的身高、体型尺寸没有登记。
资料未描述她的伤情、配饰、随身物品，不能据此写成“确认没有”。
所需正／背／侧细节（如外套背部结构、口袋）需在主图选定后逐项核对。
